text:
maria: FYI customer reported that when they apply two promo codes in quick succession via the public API, the second one overwrites the first instead of stacking.

alex: Got a reproduction? any request ids or payloads?

maria: Repro steps from the customer (they used two concurrent requests):
1) POST /v1/accounts/ACME/apply_promo {"code": "PROMO10"} 
2) POST /v1/accounts/ACME/apply_promo {"code": "PROMO5"} (sent ~50ms later)

They said responses were 200 for both but final account shows only PROMO5.

maria: They attached api logs, here's the relevant chunk: 
```
req_id=rcp-01G7X2Z response=200 body={"applied_codes":["PROMO10"]}
req_id=rcp-01G7X3A response=200 body={"applied_codes":["PROMO5"]}
```

support-bot: (automated) Opened support ticket #SUP-3242 and assigned to support queue.

alex: Seems like an upsert vs append bug in the promo service. Could be race on the account promotion row. I can try to reproduce locally with a fast loop.

jordan: If it's a race, we may be missing transactional merge when adding codes. Current impl does `UPDATE accounts SET promo_codes = $1 WHERE id = $id` after reading existing list — classic read-modify-write race.

alex: Repro'd with a small script using two concurrent curl requests, same behavior. Patch idea: switch to `UPDATE ... SET promo_codes = promo_codes || $new_code` using DB array append + unique constraint, or use SELECT FOR UPDATE.

sree: Oncall pinged. @eng-oncall if we want a hotfix: enforce row-level lock in apply flow and add optimistic locking header for clients. Also add tests for concurrent apply.

maria: Customer wants a mitigation ASAP — temporary workaround: ask them to use `apply_bulk_promo` which takes a single request with both codes in the array (server will canonicalize), or add 200ms retry/backoff.

alex: Filed bug INF-4723 and started a PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2345 — implements SELECT FOR UPDATE + dedupe.

jordan: Will also add an API-level validation to return 409 if an overlapping promo application is in flight for the same account to make clients aware.

maria: Noted. I told customer: use bulk endpoint for now and we'll patch infra with a release tomorrow. They accepted the workaround. :thumbsup:

sree: Adding postmortem label and putting a small monitoring metric to count concurrent promo apply collisions. Metric name: `promo.apply.concurrent_conflict`.

alex: Tests and a migration for existing rows are in the PR. Will request review from @jordan and merge after green CI.

maria: Thanks all — closing the support loop once INF-4723 is merged and deployed.
